# Rappholt Photo

## About
Rappholt Photo is a professional wedding videography business based in Svedala, Skåne, Sweden, serving the greater Malmö and Skåne region. Founded by Jens Rappholt, a videographer with over 15 years of professional photography and filmmaking experience.

## Services
- **Wedding Films**: Cinematic wedding highlight films (4–6 minutes), filmed in 6K RAW
- **Half-Day Package**: 4–5 hours on-site, covering ceremony and reception. Price range from 14,000 SEK.
- **Full-Day Package**: 10–12 hours on-site, from preparations to party. Price range up to 25,000 SEK.
- **Destination Weddings**: Available throughout Sweden and internationally. Travel and accommodation costs added.
- All packages include drone footage (weather permitting) and delivery within 5 days.

## Equipment
- Camera: Panasonic S1H (full-frame cinema camera)
- Stabilization: DJI RS3 Pro in Tilta rig + Easyrig Vario 5
- Recording: Blackmagic Video Assist 12G (6K RAW)
- Focus: DJI LiDAR autofocus
- Audio: On-rig microphone + 2 wireless microphones
- Post-production: DaVinci Resolve (professional color grading)

## Key Differentiators
- 5-day delivery (industry average is 4–8 weeks)
- 6K RAW recording for maximum quality and color grading flexibility
- Professional cinema equipment (not a photographer with a camera)
- Drone footage included in all packages
- 15+ years of professional imaging experience

## Service Area
Primary: Malmö, Lund, Helsingborg, Ystad, Trelleborg, Svedala, Österlen, Skanör — all of Skåne, Sweden.
Extended: All of Sweden and international destinations.
